errors.text: The proposed model is trained mainly on ordered-compound properties and hand-crafted elemental descriptors; such a property-prediction model is not demonstrated to be an interatomic potential that reproduces DFT liquid-phase configurations or the MTP–DFT energy-difference distribution required for reliable FEP.

It identifies lattice distortion and magnetic entropy as the primary mediators, whereas the target mechanism depends on low-variance MTP-to-DFT energy differences, electronic Gibbs-energy contributions, and solid-state short-range order; high-temperature magnetic effects were found negligible in the target.

The benchmark changes the target TaVCrW system to TaNbHfZr and focuses on Laves/B2 precipitation and kinetic phase separation rather than liquid–solid free-energy convergence, so it does not directly validate the intended melting calculation.

The falsification rule compares computational cost against EAM rather than against the expensive TOR-TILD/DFT thermodynamic-integration baseline, making the efficiency criterion internally inconsistent.
